name: zvideo_dd_image_ensure_surface_for_current_device
description: zVideo_dd::Image_EnsureSurfaceForCurrentDevice releases an image-owned DirectDraw surface when video is initialized and clears stale surface and pixel pointers.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a8650 validates the g_zVideo_IsInitialized guard, optional IDirectDrawSurface3::Release through vtable slot 2, and clearing of image->surface and image->pixels when a surface pointer is present.
